units.source_text: 阶上传来阎罗王的声音，声大如雷。

en.t: From above the steps came the voice of King Yama, loud as thunder.

units.source_text: 杜子春慌慌张张想要回话，突然想起铁冠子的嘱托“缄默不言”，于是他只是低头不语，像是哑巴一样。

en.t: Du Zichun anxiously tried to answer, but suddenly remembered Tieguanzi's warning to remain silent, so he merely lowered his head without speaking, as if he were mute.

units.source_text: 阎罗王抬手举起手里的铁笏板，髭须倒竖在脸上，凶神恶煞地叱道：

en.t: King Yama raised his hand and lifted the iron tablet he held; his beard bristled across his face as he roared with a terrifying glare:
